name: Bronwyn Rodgers
story: Bronwyn Rodgers is documented as Pāmu’s Geospatial Services Manager. Eagle’s customer case records GIS supporting winter-grazing decisions through ArcGIS Online and Survey123, while the 2019 user conference records her presenting Pāmu’s use of GIS for natural and built asset management.
